```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The personal saving rate is at its lowest since the Great Depression.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Currently, 75 million working Americans—roughly half the workforce—lack employer-based retirement plans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for creating automatic workplace pensions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People can add to their pension, or can opt out at any time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The savings account will be easily transferred between jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People can control the savings account themselves if they become self-employed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for ensuring savings incentives are fair to all workers by matching half of the initial $1000 of savings for families that need help.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Employers will have an easy opportunity to match employee savings.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Prediction that this program will increase the saving participation rate for low- and middle-income workers from its current 15 percent to 80 percent.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for good pensions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for adopting measures to preserve and protect existing public and private pension plans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for requiring that employees who have company pensions receive annual disclosures about their pension fund's investments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This will put a secure retirement within reach for millions of working families.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
